title: Victim sees UFO lights at Zorro Ranch and wakes in a lab

tellings.quote:
I saw a UFO when I was there, you know,
outside at New Mexico. I went to have a
cigarette and I saw a weird like lights
flying and then I had the weird thing
waking up in the lab.

plain: A woman named Juliet Byron, who describes herself as a victim of the financier Jeffrey Epstein, says that around 2002, at his Zorro Ranch in New Mexico, she stepped outside for a cigarette and saw strange lights flying overhead. She says that afterward she had the odd experience of waking up in a lab. She told this on a Jesse Michels podcast episode about Epstein and claims of alien contact, where it was offered as a possible tie between the two.
